scope: Reconciliation of recorded historical UNSAT and saved proof logs; no new solver/checker run. SAT answers are outside UNSAT certification. History is the selected run, not a union of all revisions/configurations.

user_scope.exclusion: Any declared positive-arity function with a Bool argument, as classified by the original lexical selector screen.

export_timeout_statistics.meaning: Export includes solving, collection, CORE reduction and serialization; absence of a recorded marker is not a claim about historical solvability.

signature_screen_limit: Reuses the original lexical declare-fun screen, including positive-arity Bool results; not a complete SMT-LIB parser or post-lowering compatibility proof.
